# @Generated by scripts_engineering_department/in_game/common/scripted_effects/gen_tv_wonder_level_change_effects.py
#   Data:    data/wonders.yaml + data/unique_wonders.yaml
#   Regen:   conda run --no-capture-output -n eu5 python scripts_engineering_department/in_game/common/scripted_effects/gen_tv_wonder_level_change_effects.py
# Do not edit directly - modify the data file and re-run the generator.

# ===== Public interface =====
# The only supported way for other features to change a completed wonder's level.
# One call = one level. Same-day repeated calls read the pre-change building level
# (level changes are queued engine tasks), so callers wanting several steps must
# space them across days. See docs/design/Wonder_Level_Change_Interface.md.

# Location scope. wonder = generic key from data/wonders.yaml, style = ceremony style 1-3.
# style only matters when founding from level 0; an existing wonder keeps its style.
tv_wonder_raise_generic_level_effect = {
	tv_wonder_$wonder$_raise_level_effect = yes
}

# Location scope. wonder = generic key. Level 1 -> 0 destroys the wonder.
tv_wonder_lower_generic_level_effect = {
	tv_wonder_$wonder$_lower_generic_level_effect = yes
}

# Any scope. wonder = unique key from data/unique_wonders.yaml; acts on its fixed location.
tv_wonder_raise_unique_level_effect = {
	tv_wonder_$wonder$_raise_unique_level_effect = yes
}

# Any scope. wonder = unique key. Level 1 -> 0 destroys the wonder.
tv_wonder_lower_unique_level_effect = {
	tv_wonder_$wonder$_lower_unique_level_effect = yes
}

# ===== Shared helpers (internal; called by the per-wonder dispatchers) =====

# Location scope. $building$ = building_type:X, $wonder_id$ = N, $sync_event_id$ = 94XX.
# Auto-generated 'Gains 1 [BUILDING_TYPE.GetName]' tooltip conveys the change;
# the cap-failure branch shows a custom_tooltip instead.
tv_wonder_raise_final_building_level_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = $building$ value >= 6 } }
		custom_tooltip = { text = TV_WONDER_LEVEL_RAISE_CAPPED_TT }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = $building$ value >= 5 } }
		if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_location_scale_allows_level_trigger = { wonder_id = $wonder_id$ level = 6 } }
			change_building_level_in_location = { building = $building$ value = 1 owner = owner }
			hidden_effect = { trigger_event_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.$sync_event_id$ days = 1 } }
		}
		else = { custom_tooltip = { text = TV_WONDER_LEVEL_RAISE_CAPPED_TT } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = $building$ value >= 4 } }
		if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_location_scale_allows_level_trigger = { wonder_id = $wonder_id$ level = 5 } }
			change_building_level_in_location = { building = $building$ value = 1 owner = owner }
			hidden_effect = { trigger_event_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.$sync_event_id$ days = 1 } }
		}
		else = { custom_tooltip = { text = TV_WONDER_LEVEL_RAISE_CAPPED_TT } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = $building$ value >= 3 } }
		if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_location_scale_allows_level_trigger = { wonder_id = $wonder_id$ level = 4 } }
			change_building_level_in_location = { building = $building$ value = 1 owner = owner }
			hidden_effect = { trigger_event_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.$sync_event_id$ days = 1 } }
		}
		else = { custom_tooltip = { text = TV_WONDER_LEVEL_RAISE_CAPPED_TT } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = $building$ value >= 2 } }
		if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_location_scale_allows_level_trigger = { wonder_id = $wonder_id$ level = 3 } }
			change_building_level_in_location = { building = $building$ value = 1 owner = owner }
			hidden_effect = { trigger_event_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.$sync_event_id$ days = 1 } }
		}
		else = { custom_tooltip = { text = TV_WONDER_LEVEL_RAISE_CAPPED_TT } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = $building$ value >= 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_location_scale_allows_level_trigger = { wonder_id = $wonder_id$ level = 2 } }
			change_building_level_in_location = { building = $building$ value = 1 owner = owner }
			hidden_effect = { trigger_event_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.$sync_event_id$ days = 1 } }
		}
		else = { custom_tooltip = { text = TV_WONDER_LEVEL_RAISE_CAPPED_TT } }
	}
}

# Location scope. $building$ = building_type:X, $sync_event_id$ = 94XX.
# Levels 2-6 use the auto-generated 'Loses 1 [BUILDING_TYPE.GetName]' tooltip;
# level 1 → 0 uses a custom_description so the player sees 'destroyed'.
tv_wonder_lower_final_building_level_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = $building$ value >= 2 } }
		change_building_level_in_location = { building = $building$ value = -1 }
		hidden_effect = { trigger_event_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.$sync_event_id$ days = 1 } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = $building$ value >= 1 } }
		custom_description = {
			text = tv_wonder_level_destroyed_text
			value = $building$
			change_building_level_in_location = { building = $building$ value = -1 }
			hidden_effect = { trigger_event_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.$sync_event_id$ days = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

# Location scope. $building$ = building_type:X, $sync_event_id$ = 94XX.
tv_wonder_found_final_building_level_effect = {
	custom_description = {
		text = tv_wonder_level_founded_text
		value = $building$
		construct_building = { building_type = $building$ cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" instant = yes }
		hidden_effect = {
			tv_wonder_trigger_final_building_completion_sync_hidden_event_effect = yes
			trigger_event_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.$sync_event_id$ days = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# ===== Active Engineering Department project at the same site =====
# Location scope. The owner is building/expanding this same wonder here, so the
# raise advances the project by one level instead of touching the final building.
# Hover only renders persistent project state; the mutation runs in the immediate
# of tv_engineering_department.207, which also explains the change.
tv_wonder_request_external_project_level_raise_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { owner ?= { tv_wonder_project_level_below_scale_tier_trigger = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = { owner ?= { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 0 } }
			custom_description = {
				text = tv_wonder_level_raised_project_text
				value = 1
				hidden_effect = {
					owner = { tv_wonder_queue_external_project_level_raise_effect = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner ?= { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 1 } }
			custom_description = {
				text = tv_wonder_level_raised_project_text
				value = 2
				hidden_effect = {
					owner = { tv_wonder_queue_external_project_level_raise_effect = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner ?= { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 2 } }
			custom_description = {
				text = tv_wonder_level_raised_project_text
				value = 3
				hidden_effect = {
					owner = { tv_wonder_queue_external_project_level_raise_effect = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner ?= { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 3 } }
			custom_description = {
				text = tv_wonder_level_raised_project_text
				value = 4
				hidden_effect = {
					owner = { tv_wonder_queue_external_project_level_raise_effect = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner ?= { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 4 } }
			custom_description = {
				text = tv_wonder_level_raised_project_text
				value = 5
				hidden_effect = {
					owner = { tv_wonder_queue_external_project_level_raise_effect = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { owner ?= { var:tv_wonder_level ?= 5 } }
			custom_description = {
				text = tv_wonder_level_raised_project_text
				value = 6
				hidden_effect = {
					owner = { tv_wonder_queue_external_project_level_raise_effect = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = { custom_tooltip = { text = TV_WONDER_LEVEL_RAISE_PROJECT_CAPPED_TT } }
}

# Country scope. Collapses same-day duplicate requests into one queued raise.
tv_wonder_queue_external_project_level_raise_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_external_project_level_raise_pending } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_external_project_level_raise_pending value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.207 }
	}
}

tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_raise_existing_final_building_level_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_sanctuary value >= 1 } }
		tv_wonder_raise_final_building_level_effect = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_sanctuary wonder_id = 1 sync_event_id = 9401 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_sanctuary value >= 1 } }
		tv_wonder_raise_final_building_level_effect = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_sanctuary wonder_id = 1 sync_event_id = 9401 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_sanctuary value >= 1 } }

	}

# Location scope. Founds style 1 when no sacred_mountain stands here.
tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_raise_level_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_owner = yes } }
		custom_tooltip = { text = TV_WONDER_LEVEL_RAISE_UNOWNED_TT }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_active_project_for_trigger = { wonder_id = 1 } }
		tv_wonder_request_external_project_level_raise_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_sanctuary value >= 1 } location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_sanctuary value >= 1 } location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_sanctuary value >= 1 } } }
		tv_wonder_sacred_mountain_raise_existing_final_building_level_effect = yes
	}
	else = {
		tv_wonder_found_final_building_level_effect = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_golden_sanctuary sync_event_id = 9401 }
	}
}

		limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_spice_trade_stations value >= 1 } }
		tv_wonder_raise_final_building_level_effect = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_spice_trade_stations wonder_id = 37 sync_event_id = 9437 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_spice_trade_stations value >= 1 } }
		tv_wonder_raise_final_building_level_effect = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_spice_trade_stations wonder_id = 37 sync_event_id = 9437 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_spice_trade_stations value >= 1 } }
		tv_wonder_raise_final_building_level_effect = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_spice_trade_stations wonder_id = 37 sync_event_id = 9437 }
	}
}

# Location scope. Founds style 1 when no maritime_trade_station_network stands here.
tv_wonder_maritime_trade_station_network_raise_level_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_owner = yes } }
		custom_tooltip = { text = TV_WONDER_LEVEL_RAISE_UNOWNED_TT }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_active_project_for_trigger = { wonder_id = 37 } }
		tv_wonder_request_external_project_level_raise_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_spice_trade_stations value >= 1 } location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_spice_trade_stations value >= 1 } location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_spice_trade_stations value >= 1 } } }
		tv_wonder_maritime_trade_station_network_raise_existing_final_building_level_effect = yes
	}
	else = {
		tv_wonder_found_final_building_level_effect = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_spice_trade_stations sync_event_id = 9437 }
	}
}

			limit = { NOT = { has_owner = yes } }
			custom_tooltip = { text = TV_WONDER_LEVEL_RAISE_UNOWNED_TT }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_active_project_for_trigger = { wonder_id = 105 } }
			tv_wonder_request_external_project_level_raise_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_potala_palace_inaugurated value >= 1 } }
			tv_wonder_unique_potala_palace_raise_existing_final_building_level_effect = yes
		}
		else = {
			tv_wonder_found_final_building_level_effect = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_potala_palace_inaugurated sync_event_id = 9505 }
		}
	}

			limit = { NOT = { has_owner = yes } }
			custom_tooltip = { text = TV_WONDER_LEVEL_RAISE_UNOWNED_TT }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_active_project_for_trigger = { wonder_id = 114 } }
			tv_wonder_request_external_project_level_raise_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_venetian_arsenal_inaugurated value >= 1 } }
			tv_wonder_unique_venetian_arsenal_raise_existing_final_building_level_effect = yes
		}
		else = {
			tv_wonder_found_final_building_level_effect = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_venetian_arsenal_inaugurated sync_event_id = 9514 }
		}
	}
}

		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_owner = yes } }
			custom_tooltip = { text = TV_WONDER_LEVEL_RAISE_UNOWNED_TT }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_active_project_for_trigger = { wonder_id = 123 } }
			tv_wonder_request_external_project_level_raise_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_cahokia_mounds_inaugurated value >= 1 } }
			tv_wonder_unique_cahokia_mounds_raise_existing_final_building_level_effect = yes
		}
		else = {
			tv_wonder_found_final_building_level_effect = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_cahokia_mounds_inaugurated sync_event_id = 9523 }
		}
	}
}

		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_active_project_for_trigger = { wonder_id = 141 } }
			tv_wonder_request_external_project_level_raise_effect = yes

		else_if = {

		}
		else = {
			tv_wonder_found_final_building_level_effect = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_stonehenge_inaugurated sync_event_id = 9541 }
		}
	}

tv_wonder_unique_meteora_monasteries_raise_unique_level_effect = {
	location:trikala = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_owner = yes } }
			custom_tooltip = { text = TV_WONDER_LEVEL_RAISE_UNOWNED_TT }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_active_project_for_trigger = { wonder_id = 150 } }
			tv_wonder_request_external_project_level_raise_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_meteora_monasteries_inaugurated value >= 1 } }
			tv_wonder_unique_meteora_monasteries_raise_existing_final_building_level_effect = yes
		}
		else = {
			tv_wonder_found_final_building_level_effect = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_meteora_monasteries_inaugurated sync_event_id = 9550 }
		}
	}
}

		tv_wonder_raise_final_building_level_effect = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_wat_arun_inaugurated wonder_id = 240 sync_event_id = 9640 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_wat_arun_inaugurated value >= 1 } }
		tv_wonder_raise_final_building_level_effect = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_wat_arun_inaugurated wonder_id = 240 sync_event_id = 9640 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Always acts on the fixed site location:ayodhya.
tv_wonder_unique_wat_arun_raise_unique_level_effect = {
	location:ayodhya = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_owner = yes } }
			custom_tooltip = { text = TV_WONDER_LEVEL_RAISE_UNOWNED_TT }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { tv_wonder_location_has_active_project_for_trigger = { wonder_id = 240 } }
			tv_wonder_request_external_project_level_raise_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_wat_arun_inaugurated value >= 1 } }
			tv_wonder_unique_wat_arun_raise_existing_final_building_level_effect = yes
		}
		else = {
			tv_wonder_found_final_building_level_effect = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_wat_arun_inaugurated sync_event_id = 9640 }
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_unique_wat_arun_lower_unique_level_effect = {
	location:ayodhya = {
		if = {
			limit = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_wat_arun_inaugurated value >= 1 } }
			tv_wonder_lower_final_building_level_effect = { building = building_type:tv_wonder_unique_wat_arun_inaugurated sync_event_id = 9640 }
		}
		else = { custom_tooltip = { text = TV_WONDER_LEVEL_LOWER_ABSENT_TT } }
	}
}
